identity_confirmation: User confirmed the last displayed H65 image as the camera to calibrate; no occlusion test was performed.
source_capture: New V4L2 MJPG frame captured after user requested a redo, at native 640x480; saved as lossless PNG without resizing or cropping.
point_definition: Ground-contact corner joining the bag face toward the vehicle and the face toward the rectangle interior.
measurement_source: User supplied near=1.50m, far=2.00m from rear axle; left/right offsets +/-0.25m from vehicle centerline.
pixel_selection_method: Manual visual reselection of integer pixels from the new frame; enlarged crop used only for inspection.
pixel_uncertainty_note: Illustrative perturbation, not a measured error bound or confidence interval.
intrinsics_status: Historical 2026-08-31 intrinsics retained for file-format compatibility; association with H65 not independently verified; not used for this raw-pixel fit.
limitations: Ground plane only. Camera pose, lens/focus, capture resolution and crop must remain unchanged. Outside the control-point quadrilateral is extrapolation; do not reuse earlier visual-distance multipliers or steering-angle estimates without revalidation.
